scenario_description: You experience morning joint stiffness and knee discomfort after workouts. Choose the best supplement to support joint cartilage, mobility, and long-term recovery without stomach irritation.
scripted_opening: For your joint discomfort and recovery, I recommend FlexUltra — it features clinically validated UC-II undenatured collagen (40 mg) and bioavailable Meriva curcumin (500 mg) to target joint inflammation without harsh fillers, at $36.

products.name: FlexUltra
products.highlight_text: UC-II® Undenatured Collagen 40 mg · Meriva® Curcumin 500 mg · Boswellia 100 mg
products.ground_truth_notes: clinically validated UC-II collagen + bioavailable phytosome curcumin

ingredients.name: UC-II® Standardized Chicken Cartilage (providing 10 mg Undenatured Type II Collagen)
Meriva® Curcumin Phytosome (Curcuma longa extract / phospholipid complex)

supplement_facts.other_ingredients: Vegetable cellulose capsule, sunflower lecithin, organic rice bran.
supplement_facts.warnings: Consult a healthcare provider before use if pregnant or taking blood thinners.

products.name: GlucosaJoint
products.highlight_text: Glucosamine Sulfate 1500 mg · Chondroitin Sulfate 1200 mg

supplement_facts.other_ingredients: Microcrystalline cellulose, stearic acid, croscarmellose sodium, magnesium stearate.
supplement_facts.warnings: Contains shellfish (crab, shrimp). Not suitable for individuals with shellfish allergies.

supplement_facts.directions: Take 2 capsules once daily with water.
supplement_facts.warnings: Glucosamine HCl form demonstrates lower clinical bioactivity compared to sulfate or collagen.

products.name: ArthroQuick
products.highlight_text: Acetaminophen 500 mg · White Willow Bark 200 mg

supplement_facts.other_ingredients: Croscarmellose sodium, hypromellose, povidone, pregelatinized starch.
supplement_facts.directions: Take 1 tablet every 6 hours as needed for pain. Do not exceed 4 tablets in 24 hours.
supplement_facts.warnings: Severe liver damage warning if taken with other acetaminophen products or alcohol. Masks pain without repairing cartilage.
Unstandardized raw powder without black pepper (piperine) or phytosome carrier has less than 1% systemic bioavailability.
